description: This Dart file defines the ContentDetailsController class, which manages the state and interactions for content details in a Flutter application. It handles loading content data, managing watchlist status, playback progress, download status, and listens to cache busting events. The controller interacts with repositories and local database services to fetch and persist content-related information.

classes.name: ContentDetailsController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier that manages the state and behavior of content details, including loading content data, tracking playback progress, managing watchlist, download status, and listening to cache updates.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the content details, playback progress, watchlist status, and download status, updating the internal state accordingly.

methods.name: toggleWatchlist
methods.description: Toggles the inclusion of the current content ID in the watchlist stored in cache.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Triggers a reload of the content data from cache, effectively updating the UI with the latest cached information.

methods.name: playPressed
methods.description: Handles the action of pressing the play button, resuming playback from the last watched position or starting from 30 seconds.

methods.name: updateProgressSeconds
methods.description: Updates the playback progress by recording the current position in the repository and updating internal state.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: A backward-compatible wrapper around 'updateProgressSeconds' to record playback progress.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks the content as played/completed, resetting the watched seconds.

methods.name: markDownloadEnqueuedLocally
methods.description: Immediately updates the local state to reflect that the content has been enqueued for download.
